model_system: 2D Rashba model with noncollinear spin textures (spin spiral and Néel skyrmion)

key_params.chemical_potential: mu = 0 eV for phase diagrams; general analytic formulas given for arbitrary mu
key_params.example_spin_spiral_params: Delta_xc = 0.9 eV, hbar alpha_R = 2.0 eV A

headline_claim: For zero spin-orbit coupling, the topological orbital magnetization is M_tom = (1/4) chi_LP^(up+down) B_eff^z sgn(Delta_xc) (1 - 3 mu^2/Delta_xc^2) for |mu| < |Delta_xc|, and zero otherwise.
replication_difficulty: high - requires semiclassical Green-function/gradient-expansion derivation plus numerical evaluation over Rashba-model parameter space for textured magnetization.
